Nairn has been with Supreme Steel as a Welding Engineer-in-Training since October 2017. Nairn graduated in Fall 2017 from the University of Alberta with a PhD in Materials Engineering, and joined Supreme directly following successful completion of his defence. As a welding engineer-in-training, his responsibilities include creating and monitoring of WPDS, troubleshooting for the production team both in the shop and in the field with repairs, helping to overhaul the quality system, assisting project teams, and addressing general welding issues. 

Nairn is actively involved in the American Welding Society (AWS) Technical Committee and the IIW Young Leaders Task Group. He was a past chair of AWS/CWA University of Alberta Student Chapter.

##### Prior Degrees

PhD in Materials Engineering

##### Project

*Solidification Theory and Optimization of Chromium Carbide Overlays*

To bring a deeper understanding to chromium carbide overlays. In particular, the development and affirmation of a growth model describing the diffusion-controlled growth of faceted primary carbide needles enables a greater control over the final microstructure and properties of the overlay.
